post.summary: Run a user analytics query
post.description:
Runs a query of the user analytics catalog (see `GET /api/analytics/_schema`) on the PostgreSQL database of the active user-analytics data exporter and returns its result.

This is how the user analytics dashboards get their data: read a dashboard with `GET /apis/analytics.otoroshi.io/v1/user-dashboards/{id}`, then run one query per widget with its `query` and `params`.

The result is always restricted to the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header, and is cached for 30 seconds unless `nocache` is `true`. Only leader instances serve this endpoint.

Built-in queries (admin extensions can add more):

| id | shape | params | compare |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requests_total` | `scalar` | | yes |
| `errors_total` | `scalar` | | yes |
| `requests_by_status` | `pie` | | no |
| `requests_by_method` | `pie` | | no |
| `requests_by_route` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_by_api` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_by_apikey` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_by_user` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_by_domain` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_by_country` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `top_error_routes` | `topN` | `top_n` | no |
| `requests_per_second` | `timeseries` (`points`) | | yes |
| `error_rate_ts` | `timeseries` (`points`) | | yes |
| `duration_avg_ts` | `timeseries` (`points`) | | yes |
| `overhead_avg_ts` | `timeseries` (`points`) | | yes |
| `duration_percentiles_ts` | `timeseries` (`series`: `p50`, `p75`, `p95`, `p99`) | | yes |
| `traffic_in_out_ts` | `timeseries` (`series`: `data_in`, `data_out`) | | yes |
| `requests_by_status_class_ts` | `timeseries` (`series`: `2xx`, `3xx`, `4xx`, `5xx`) | | yes |
| `response_time_heatmap` | `heatmap` | | no |

parameters.name: Otoroshi-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant whose data is read. Results are always restricted to this tenant

400.description: Malformed body, or the query failed on the database

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is neither a super admin nor allowed to read the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header

404.description: Unknown query id, or the instance is not a leader

412.description: No user-analytics data exporter is active

500.description: The analytics runtime is not initialized

get.summary: Get the catalog of user analytics queries
get.description: Lists every query `POST /api/analytics/_query` can run, admin extensions included, with the shape of its result, the widget that displays it by default, its parameters and whether it supports period comparison. Also lists the widget types a dashboard widget can use.

parameters.name: Otoroshi-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant whose data is read. Results are always restricted to this tenant

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is neither a super admin nor allowed to read the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header

500.description: The analytics runtime is not initialized

get.summary: List the event families user analytics can store
get.description: Lists the event families (projections) the user-analytics data exporter can store, admin extensions included, and the table each one is written to. Any of them can be left out with the `excluded_projections` setting of the exporter.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The PostgreSQL schema used to compute the `table` of each projection

parameters.name: table_prefix
parameters.description: The table prefix used to compute the `table` of each projection

parameters.name: Otoroshi-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant whose data is read. Results are always restricted to this tenant

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is neither a super admin nor allowed to read the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header

post.summary: Test the connection to a user analytics database
post.description: Opens a single connection to the PostgreSQL database described by the body (the `config` of a user-analytics data exporter) and runs `SELECT 1` on it. Super admin only.

requestBody.description: the settings of the database to test

400.description: Invalid settings, or the connection failed (`ok` is `false` and `error` tells why)

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is not a super admin

post.summary: Make a user-analytics data exporter the active one
post.description: Makes the user-analytics data exporter `id` the one user analytics reads from (flagged by its `otoroshi:user-analytics:active` metadata), removes the flag from the other ones, then creates the default dashboards that are missing. Super admin only.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the user-analytics data exporter

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is not a super admin

404.description: No user-analytics data exporter with this id

post.summary: Restore the default user dashboards
post.description: Creates again the default dashboards that are missing. Existing dashboards are never modified. Super admin only.

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is not a super admin

500.description: The default dashboards could not be created

get.summary: List the fired events of a user alert
get.description: Returns the times the user alert fired, newest first, read from the database of the active user-analytics data exporter and restricted to the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header.

parameters.name: alertId
parameters.description: The id of the user alert

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of events returned

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of events skipped

parameters.name: seen
parameters.description: Only return the acknowledged events (`true`) or the not yet acknowledged ones (`false`). All of them when missing

parameters.name: Otoroshi-Tenant
parameters.description: The tenant whose data is read. Results are always restricted to this tenant

401.description: You have to provide an Api Key. Api Key can be passed using basic http authentication

403.description: The caller is neither a super admin nor allowed to read the tenant given by the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header

412.description: No user-analytics data exporter is active

500.description: The database of the active user-analytics data exporter could not be queried
